title: Ashpreet Bedi on X Systems Engineering Building Agentic Software That Works X
feynman_summary:
Systems engineering emerged when Bell Labs discovered that optimizing individual components couldn't ensure proper system behavior during telephone network construction. Today's agentic software development repeats these mistakes by patching isolated components like creating virtual filesystems or sandboxing bash. 

Software engineering is fundamentally systems engineering. Building functional agentic software requires coordinating five layers: 1) Agent engineering for deterministic behaviors; 2) Data engineering to manage contextual knowledge; 3) Security engineering with JWT-backed permissions; 4) Interface engineering unifying multi-surface access; 5) Infrastructure engineering using standard deployment patterns. While 95% resembles traditional services, the 5% difference involves accommodating longer requests and streaming responses.

The Dash prototype demonstrates systemic design: layered contextual data improves query accuracy, databases replace files for storage, and tool permissions are configuration-based rather than prompt-dependent. Security boundaries are enforced at system level, with all interfaces sharing identical agent logic. Deployment uses containerization with minor adjustments for timeout and streaming needs.
chinese_translation:
系统工程：构建能正常工作的智能体软件

20世纪40年代，贝尔实验室在构建国家电话网络时发现：系统整体行为取决于组件间的交互方式，而非单个组件的优化。这催生了系统工程学科。当前智能体软件开发正重蹈覆辙——人们试图通过虚拟文件系统解决存储限制，用沙箱修补bash的安全缺陷，这些都是孤立优化局部而忽视系统整体的表现。

软件工程本质就是系统工程。构建智能体软件需要统筹五个层面：1)智能体工程（确定行为逻辑）；2)数据工程（管理上下文数据）；3)安全工程（权限控制与隔离）；4)接口工程（统一多入口认证）；5)基础设施工程（部署与扩展）。其中95%与传统服务相同，仅5%需适配智能体特性（如长时请求、流式响应）。

实践案例Dash展示了系统工程的威力：通过分层上下文数据提升查询质量，用数据库而非文件存储会话，严格区分只读/写入权限配置而非依赖提示词。安全边界由系统层面保障，所有接口共享同一套代理逻辑。采用标准容器化部署，仅需调整超时设置和流式支持。
